updateSection:
- MERGES with existing - only send fields you want to change - Use `content` object for text/layout changes, metadata fields (status/hidden/sortOrder) for visibility - Call getSectionTemplate first to know available field names
To update section content (text, layout, styling), pass a `content` object: - Text: `content: { heading: "New Title" }` - Layout: `content: { layout: "image-left" }` or `content: { layout: "image-right" }` - Multiple: `content: { heading: "Title", layout: "image-left", backgroundColor: "gray" }`
"RTL" (right-to-left) = `layout: "image-left"` (image on left, text on right) "LTR" (left-to-right) = `layout: "image-right"` (image on right, text on left)
imageField must match section schema (e.g., "backgroundImage", "image", "cover")
